verdict.rationale: Jitsu is an event-collection and warehouse-streaming CDP, so AI decisioning is a fair axis for it. However, the evidence shows no agent that autonomously picks messages, timing or channels per customer, no guardrail configuration, and no lift measurement. Its MCP server lets external AI agents manage pipeline configuration, which is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI decisioning agents pick messages, timing, and channels per customer autonomously within guardrails I set, with measurable lift
